podcasts.description: My guests today are Brad Gerstner, founder of Altimeter Capital, and Geoffrey Canada, founder of Harlem Children's Zone. Geoffrey spent decades helping disadvantaged kids get a great education, but it takes more than that to achieve the American dream. Without savings, you’re one emergency away from bankruptcy.
